items.title: Fox (FOXA) Closes Its Roku Deal And Gives Anthony Wood A Digital Role
items.summary: Fox (NasdaqGS: FOXA) has completed its acquisition of streaming platform Roku, bringing the service fully under Fox Corporation. Roku founder Anthony Wood has been appointed to the Fox board and named Co-Chair of the new FOX Digital Platforms division. Fox has created the FOX Digital Platforms unit to house its expanded streaming and digital assets following the Roku transaction. items.title: Newsmax Is Suing to Break Up Fox’s $22 Billion Roku Deal
items.summary: Fox promised regulators it would play fair with rivals, but it never put that promise in a binding document. Newsmax now wants a judge to ask why, and the answer could decide whether a closed megadeal survives.

items.title: Inside Stanley Druckenmiller’s Portfolio: Every Move He Made in the Third Quarter
items.summary: Key TakeawaysStanley Druckenmiller’s Duquesne Family Office sold all of its Alphabet and United Airlines stock in the third quarter and added to Amazon, Fox and Unity Software, its latest 13F shows. Amazon is now the fund’s third-largest holding, at 772,600 shares worth $192 million, plus call options.

items.title: Newsmax sues Fox to block $22 billion Roku acquisition
items.summary: Investing.com -- Newsmax filed a lawsuit on Wednesday against Fox to stop its $22 billion acquisition of Roku, claiming the deal damages competition in the free, ad-supported television market.
